title: GPU oversubscription glance and mitigation playbook (daily export)
body:
Purpose:
A compact daily export intended for on-call/ops and infra planning: detect pools/cluster slices showing oversubscription, correlate with latency and job queue growth, and provide immediate mitigation steps. This is a derived CSV-style export from grafana -> csv with a short operational playbook appended.

Notes on derivation:
- Export pulled from grafana dashboard 'gpu/ops/oversubscription' at 08:00 UTC on 2026-08-22.
- Metrics window: last 60 minutes aggregated to 1m.
- Oversubscription = (allocated_slices / physical_gpu_count) when using slice-based packing. Values > 1 indicate logical oversubscription.
- Latency columns (P50/P95) are request-serve latency from inference-proxy frontdoor; correlated to high oversubscription.
- Active jobs counts are unique job_ids with last_seen within window.

CSV EXPORT (columns): date,region,cluster_id,pool_name,physical_gpus,allocated_slices,oversubscription,avg_gpu_util_pct,p50_latency_ms,p95_latency_ms,active_jobs,queue_delta_15m,notes

2026-08-22,NA,cluster-aurora-07,interactive-small,8,12,1.50,62,18,85,4,High baseline util; some long-running debug jobs observed
2026-08-22,NA,cluster-aurora-07,batch-medium,16,16,1.00,48,22,120,9,Normal
2026-08-22,EU,cluster-orion-03,prod-critical,32,29,0.91,71,12,65,1,High avg util but no oversubscription
2026-08-22,EU,cluster-orion-03,dev-ephemeral,8,10,1.25,55,30,210,27,Spike in dev experiments; queue growing
2026-08-22,APAC,cluster-phi-02,interactive-small,4,6,1.50,68,24,140,12,Latency up; preemptions observed by scheduler
2026-08-22,APAC,cluster-phi-02,batch-large,24,20,0.83,40,16,40,-2,Underutilized overnight
2026-08-22,NA,cluster-lyra-01,prod-critical,48,52,1.08,78,35,220,15,Critical pool oversubscribed; P95 elevated
2026-08-22,NA,cluster-lyra-01,training-gpuhog,96,130,1.35,85,90,410,45,Training backfill causing sustained oversubscription and burst queues

Operational highlights (from the above):
- Two types of oversubscription observed: small interactive pools (1.25-1.50) correlated with latency spikes and queue growth; and large training pools (1.08-1.35) where backfill jobs are driving sustained pressure.
- prod-critical pools show high GPU util but usually keep oversubscription <=1; Lyra prod-critical crossing 1.0 is notable and should trigger mitigation.
- Dev/dev-ephemeral pools in EU and interactive pools in APAC appear to be the immediate low-risk candidates for eviction/migration to relieve hot clusters.

Quick mitigation playbook (priority ordered):
1) Emergency throttle: set interactive-small pools in cluster-aurora-07 and cluster-phi-02 to burst-mode=false and reduce max_slices_per_gpu by 25% for 30 minutes. Action owner: oncall-infra. Jira: JIRA-OPS-1721.
2) Preemptible shift: move training-gpuhog jobs on cluster-lyra-01 to spot-only nodes if not latency-sensitive; escalate to scheduling team to mark long-running training backfills for eviction. Action owner: infra-scheduler.
3) Short-term migration: schedule dev-ephemeral jobs in cluster-orion-03 to eu-fallback-01 (30-minute rolling window) until queue_delta_15m < 5. Action owner: solutions-eng.
4) Autoscaler tune: lower target_util_pct for prod-critical on lyra-01 from 75% to 68% for 2 hours; increase scale-out cooldown to prevent oscillation. Action owner: autoscale-team.
5) Capacity carve-out: reserve 8 GPUs in lyra-01 for prod-critical for the next 24 hours (dedicated slice). Requires approval from capacity-planning.

Suggested follow-ups (medium term):
- Add a 'slice prewarm' job for interactive-small pools to avoid latency cliffs when new slices are allocated.
- Review retention of long-running debug jobs and add lifecycle enforcement (max_runtime=6h).
- Run a scheduled rebalance job (non-disruptive) to pull low-priority slices to underutilized pools during off-peak (02:00-06:00 local).

Detection rules to wire into alerts (proposed):
- Alert A: prod-critical oversubscription > 1.02 for > 5m -> P0 runbook (notify oncall + paging)
- Alert B: any pool oversubscription >= 1.3 -> warn oncall + automatic throttle of burst-mode
- Alert C: queue_delta_15m >= 20 for dev/ephemeral or interactive pools -> Slack alert to devops channel

Metrics sanity checks:
- For rows with avg_gpu_util_pct > 80 and oversubscription > 1.2, correlate with p95 latency > 50ms as seen in lyra training pool. If mismatch, check exporter sampling rate.
- If physical_gpus reported <=4 but allocated_slices >=6 repeatedly, surface possible mislabel (slice packing policy change) to scheduler team.

Raw CSV preview included above; full sheet contains per-minute rows for the 60-minute window (attached to this doc in grafana-export tab).

Last action log (manual):
- 08:10 UTC: oncall reduced interactive-small max_slices on aurora-07 by 20% (temporary).
- 08:22 UTC: autoscaler flagged lyra-01 scale request; hold placed pending manual approval.

If you own a pool listed above and need help translating a mitigation into a k8s patch or autoscale config, ping @Maya (Slack) or create a ticket with prefix GPU-OPS.
